RECHECKED Sep14 2026 (prior check Sep5-6): Mt Anak Krakatau eruption episode ENDED Sep6 after ~25hrs, all affected airports (Jakarta + regional, incl KLIA) fully reopened by Sep8. Still at background Alert Level III (unchanged since July), 3km exclusion zone maintained, no tsunami threat, quieter Strombolian pattern now. No current ash disruption anywhere. Risk to this trip: LOWER than last check — essentially non-issue unless it flares again. Action unchanged: routine IndiGo status check 24-48hrs before Sep21/Sep27.

RECHECKED Sep14 2026 (prior check Sep5-6): Singapore haze TRENDING BETTER. PSI has stayed in the moderate range (68-88) since Sep11-14, down from the Sep4/Sep10 unhealthy spikes (101-123, 106). PM2.5 mostly normal-to-elevated, not unhealthy. NEA forecast still flags risk of moderate-to-low-unhealthy PSI persisting due to dry weather + SE/S winds — not declared over, but improving trend, not worsening. Still check haze.gov.sg every morning Sep21-24 as planned. N95 masks stay on packing list as contingency, lower urgency than before.

MONITORED, checked Sep6 2026: F1 Singapore GP 2026 is Oct9-11 (race weekend), full road closures Marina Centre/Padang area (Nicoll Highway, St Andrew's Rd, Raffles Blvd, Esplanade Drive, Stamford Rd, Bras Basah Rd) run Oct7-13. Your trip (Sep21-27) is ~2 weeks before the full-closure window — assessed risk LOW, no closures expected during your visit. Barrier/grandstand pre-build happens overnight in the weeks before, no full daytime closures historically — possible minor cosmetic hoarding near Padang/Esplanade during Marina Bay walks (Day1/2/4), but Spectra (Event Plaza)/Garden Rhapsody (Gardens by the Bay) venues are outside the circuit footprint. No MRT/train disruption expected (extended-hours arrangements only apply Oct9-11). Action: quick LTA newsroom recheck closer to Sep21 if barrier-work schedule gets published, otherwise no itinerary change needed.

RM10 Petronas Twin Towers photo trick, KL — street photographers near the towers charge ~RM5-10/photo. Banana leaf dining: fold leaf toward you if you enjoyed the meal, away = funeral gesture. Zero-tolerance drug laws, severe penalties. Fine City specifics: no jaywalking (zebra crossings only, enforced), no chewing gum sale/import, no loud noise after 10pm, must flush public toilets, no feeding animals/birds, no durian on public transport, no smoking outside designated areas. Stand left on MRT escalators. Make eye contact with turning drivers before crossing — cars can legally turn into pedestrian crossings
